subject: Ambulance Service Provider Transition
overview: The Medford City Council organized its leadership for 2026 and voted to refer a highly contested transition of the city's emergency medical services contract to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Election of Council President for 2026
items.summary: Elected Councilor Zac Bears to serve as Council President for 2026.

items.title: Election of Council Vice President for 2026
items.summary: Elected Councilor Emily Lazzaro to serve as Council Vice President for 2026.

items.title: Appointment of City Messenger
items.summary: Tabled the appointment of a City Messenger for 2026 and 2027 to allow for further definition of the role's modern duties.

items.title: Procedural and Administrative Matters
items.summary: Adopted the prior year's standing committee rules, transferred pending papers from 2025 to the 2026 council, and approved the minutes of the December 16, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Planning and Permitting Committee Report
items.summary: Approved a committee report detailing a draft condominium conversion ordinance.

items.title: Review of Ambulance EMS Contract Transition
items.summary: Referred a resolution to review the city's transition from Armstrong Ambulance to Cataldo Ambulance to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Common Victualler's Licenses
items.summary: Approved common victualler's licenses for Wunder HDR Holdings at 55 Station Landing and Colwyn Management, doing business as Medford Hyatt Place, at 116 Riverside Ave.

items.title: Confirmation of Acting City Clerk
items.summary: Amended and approved a resolution confirming Richard Alicio, Jr. as the acting City Clerk with equivalent clerk compensation.

items.title: Tufts SMFA Professors Contract Support
items.summary: Approved a resolution standing in solidarity with Tufts University School of the Museum of Fine Arts professors of the practice during contract negotiations.

items.title: City Services on Private Ways
items.summary: Amended and approved a resolution to hold a public forum and draft an informational FAQ document for residents living on private ways.

items.title: Union Wage Adjustments
items.summary: Approved cost-of-living salary increases for DPW superintendents, building department inspectors, and the recreation union.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Appropriations
items.summary: Approved appropriations of $37,223 for a new DPW admin vehicle and $325,000 for water main replacements.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard from residents on parking permit fees in the GLX zone, ward meetings, city ordinance updates, and Route 60 rotary maintenance.
